how_it_works_subtitle: Follow these three simple steps to get your screening result.
privacy_subtitle: Your health data is your own. All cough recordings are fully encrypted, and your personal information is never shared without your explicit consent.
tip_1_desc: Early detection saves lives. Learn more.
tip_1_full: Tuberculosis (TB) is a potentially serious infectious disease that mainly affects your lungs. The bacteria that cause tuberculosis are spread from person to person through tiny droplets released into the air via coughs and sneezes.
tip_2_full: Your lungs are vital for a healthy life. To keep them strong: Don't smoke, avoid exposure to indoor pollutants, prevent infection, and get regular check-ups. Simple breathing exercises can also help increase lung capacity.
tip_3_full: SwaaS AI is constantly evolving. Our latest update introduces 'Cough Signature Analysis 2.0', which improves detection accuracy by 15% in noisy environments. We are also rolling out a new 'Risk Prediction Map'.
record_sub_start: Hold for 5 seconds for best results
analyzing_subtitle: This may take a few seconds
result_body_low: Based on your symptoms and AI-powered cough analysis, your risk for Tuberculosis is currently low.
disclaimer: Disclaimer: This is a screening tool, not a diagnosis. If you have a persistent cough or fever, please consult a medical professional.
history_empty_sub: Records will appear here after you analyze a cough.
medical_desc_1: TB-SCAN is a screening tool designed to provide a preliminary assessment of tuberculosis risk based on cough audio analysis.
medical_warning_text: This application is not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis, clinical advice, or treatment.
medical_desc_2: If you are experiencing severe symptoms, please consult a qualified healthcare professional or visit a clinic immediately. Never disregard professional medical advice because of something you have read or interpreted through this app.
medical_agreement: By proceeding, you acknowledge that you have read and understood the nature of this screening tool.
mic_desc: To accurately assess your health, TB-SCAN needs to record and analyze your cough audio. Use simple background noise reduction environment if possible.
clinic_location_permission_denied: Permission to access location was denied
notif_desc: Turning this on allows TB-SCAN to send you important updates and reminders about your health screenings.
privacy_sec_1_text: Your privacy is important to us. This policy outlines how we handle your personal and health data.
privacy_sec_2_text: We collect audio recordings solely for the purpose of analysis. No data is shared with third parties without your consent.
privacy_sec_3_text: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest to ensure maximum security for your sensitive information.
